name: Add service, remove Cash instead of Credit and adjust tip

steps.name: Given I am on the HOME page
When I clock in the timesheet with PIN "8573"
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('8', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('5', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('7', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'PASSWORD' }) }).getByText('3', { exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title') }).locator('div.MuiDialogActions-root').getByRole('button', { name: 'CONFIRM', exact: true })
Then I should see the employee "Evelyn" in the employee list
Then I should see the "Ticket View" screen
Then I should see the "Manicure" service
When I add the "Manicure" service to my cart
Then I should see my cart showing 1 item added
When I click on the total price of "Manicure"
Expect "toBeVisible" locator('ul.xTicketFunctions__menu li').getByText('CHANGE PRICE', { exact: true }).first()
Click locator('ul.xTicketFunctions__menu li').getByText('CHANGE PRICE', { exact: true }).first()
When I pay the exact amount by "Cash"
Expect "toBeVisible" locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'Close Ticket' }) })
Expect "toContainText" locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'Close Ticket' }) }).locator('div.MuiDialogContent-root')
Expect "toContainText" locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'Close Ticket' }) }).locator('div.MuiDialogContent-root')

Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'Close Ticket' }) }).locator('div.MuiDialogActions-root').getByRole('button', { name: 'OK', exact: true })
Expect "toBeHidden" locator('div[role="dialog"]').filter({ has: locator('#alert-dialog-title').filter({ hasText: 'Close Ticket' }) })
Then I should see the selected "SERVICE" tab on the Home page
When I click on the header menu
And I select the "Manager" label in the menu list
And I select the "Ticket Adjustment" label in the expanded list
Expect "toBeVisible" locator('div.xMenu__link span').getByText('Ticket Adjustment', { exact: true })
Click locator('div.xMenu__link span').getByText('Ticket Adjustment', { exact: true })
Then I should be redirected to TICKET_ADJUSTMENT page
And I should see the "Ticket Adjustment" screen
And I should see the text "TICKET#" visible
Then I should see the first ticket with total "$21.00"
When I select the first ticket with total "$21.00"
Then I should see the service "Manicure" in my cart
And I should see the "Acrylic removal" service
When I add the "Acrylic removal" service to my cart
Then I should see the service "Acrylic removal" in my cart
Then I should see the payment history "Cash" visible in payment tab
When I remove the payment history "Cash"
Expect "toBeVisible" locator('div[role="dialog"]').getByRole('button', { name: 'Yes, void it', exact: true })
Click locator('div[role="dialog"]').getByRole('button', { name: 'Yes, void it', exact: true })
And I click on the "PAY" button
Then I should see a popup dialog with title "PAYMENT TICKET"
When I select the "Credit" payment type on the payment ticket dialog
And I fill the last 4 digits of card number "1234" on the payment ticket dialog
And I click on the element with id "payment"
Then I should see the payment history "VISA (1234)" visible in payment tab
When I adjust tip amount "10" in ticket adjustment
